qa_pair.question: A teammate wants a local project with reusable, editable components. Discover the bundled workflows, follow the construction entry to its editability module and identify whether duplicating only a master composition guarantees independent nested content. Answer yes or no.
Inspect the local capability guidance and the scene-planning guidance. Can a motion JSON file in the Lottie format be passed directly to this server's project JSON importer? Answer yes or no.

Discover the workflows for large builds and local execution limits. If operation four of a batch fails after the first three succeed, does the server guarantee an automatic rollback of all changes? Answer yes or no.

Discover the construction reference about endlessly cycling cards and compare the motion guidance. For a cyclic control with x=-1 and n=5, what nonnegative index does the recommended positive-modulo formula yield? Answer with the integer.

A designer says the old connector forbade cameras. Read both the local capability guidance and depth guidance, then check the layer operation catalog. Give the operation name for creating a native camera.

A user wants a progress control that they can keyframe on a reusable scene change. Read the reusable transition workflow and the shared editability reference. Should invisible time-driven playback override the user's manual keys? Answer yes or no.

Read the setup workflow and the local capability guidance. After offline installation diagnostics pass, which MCP tool should be called to prove communication with AE while inspecting the existing project?

Read the visual-proof guidance in the clean-rig and glass workflows and discover the available inspection/rendering tools. Which tool supplies an actual native AE frame for checking glass edges and matte output?

Inspect the local execution guidance and the operation catalog. A write times out after AE has consumed its request. Is replaying the mutation immediately, without inspecting current state, the recommended recovery? Answer yes or no.

Read the offline capability guidance and the skill index. An installed runtime needs its component-construction rules while AE is closed and the network is unavailable. Which MCP tool can return the entry and its individual reference modules?
